digest.title: Research acceleration: The view inside OpenAI
digest.tldr: Inside OpenAI, coding agents are reshaping AI research.  Explore early data on agent usage, experiment velocity, task complexity, and research acceleration.

digest.title: An Alien Mind
digest.tldr: Jakub Pachocki reflects on increasingly capable AI and the challenge of keeping it aligned.  He calls for stronger safeguards and international coordination.
